name: color-picker
title: Color Picker
description: A HEX input with a live swatch and an accessible color-selection popover.
docs:
## Overview

`ColorPicker` combines a HEX input with a clickable swatch. The swatch opens a color square and hue slider, with mouse, touch and arrow-key support. Solid colors only; no opacity.

## Usage

```tsx
import { ColorPicker } from "@/components/ui/color-picker";

<ColorPicker value={color} onValueChange={setColor} />
<ColorPicker defaultValue="#A855F7" />
```

The SDK export is `@krak-stack/registry/color-picker`. Accepted input is three or six HEX digits, with an optional `#`. Callbacks emit uppercase `#RRGGBB` values. Incomplete text stays editable; blur, Enter or Escape restores the last valid color. External value changes reset stale drafts.

Pass standard input props such as `id`, `name`, `aria-label`, `aria-describedby`, `disabled` and `readOnly`. `className` styles the input group. `disabled` and `readOnly` also prevent opening the picker.

English and French defaults follow `KrakstackProvider`. Use `locale` for an explicit override and `messages` for exact-locale or base-language message overrides, with English as the final fallback.
